requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed frontend data contract object for prescription behavior with fields: relevance_indicator, top_drugs, integrity_flag, and score_contribution.
The system must ensure the relevance_indicator field supports a finite enum set (e.g., high, medium, low, none).
The system must define top_drugs as an ordered array of drug objects with fields: name, relevance_score, and optional metadata.
The system must ensure the top_drugs array supports a maximum length constraint aligned with design_eval_p_rx_drug_mapping.
The system must define integrity_flag as a strict enum with values clean or flagged.
The system must define score_contribution as a numeric field representing contribution to overall provider score.
The system must ensure the data contract is compatible with backend payload structure from EVAL-P-RX without requiring additional transformation at render time.
The system must define optional fields to handle missing backend data without breaking MessageBubble rendering.
The system must include a version or schema identifier in the contract to support future backward compatibility.
The system must validate that incoming backend data can be mapped 1:1 into the defined contract fields.
The system must handle the exception case where top_drugs is empty by allowing an empty array and still producing a valid contract object.
The system must handle the exception case where integrity_flag is missing by defaulting to flagged.
The system must ensure the contract structure is serializable to JSON for transport in chat response payloads.
The system must ensure field names and structure align with MessageBubble.tsx consumption patterns.
The system must define clear nullability rules for each field in the contract.
The system must ensure the contract supports deterministic rendering (same input produces same structured output).
The system must ensure no extraneous fields outside the defined schema are required for rendering prescription behavior.
The system must ensure the contract can be extended without breaking existing consumers.
